race.description: Australian Meat Group Country Boosted (Bm58) Hcp
race.comment: EAST HARLEM (17) may not win often, but at this level he is usually very competitive, including his last start at Bathurst when third. He is reunited with Molly Bourke, and another honest effort is expected. SUNDROP (10) is a consistent mare who broke her win drought at her penultimate start, and then was third against 5 others at Leeton 12 days ago. Brendan Ward sticks with her, and so do we. SEASMOKE (9) was not far away in Highway company at Rosehill 2 starts back of a wide gate, and then was a solid third at Wagga last start. She is having no luck with his barrier draws, but is still worth including in all to be safe. VINARI (6) had an excuse last start, and can make amends. DUNNA RUNNA (14) strips fitter second up, and he is capable of figuring in the top 4 at a price.
